Make Search ask by a read that creates no row (or only after the query settles), and retire unused rows on both sides (keeping a row's N-13 verdict for its window). Needs a short design note first.

N-26b.title: Behind the scenes: the artist of a channel-only upload comes from the catalogue
N-26b.note: Removal trigger of N-26's `channel` stop-gap (14 Nov 2026): an upload whose title names nobody (a personal upload account, a title with no dash) keeps the uploader as its artist with basis `channel`. The proper fix is to identify the performer through the catalogue by the song's own title and length, the way N-15 identifies an artist by one of its songs, once the server owns the catalogue (P2-12, N-14). Until then those songs stay under the channel and never get an artist picture or page.
